newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada ships 13,500 T milling wheat to N. Korea.
newsitem.headline: Canada ships 13,500 T milling wheat to N. Korea.

text.p: Canada shipped 13,500 tonnes of No3 Canada Western Red Spring wheat valued at C$4.5 million to the North Korean port of Nampo from Vancouver last Thursday, the Canadian Foodgrains Bank said on Monday.
"Responses from our church agencies, donors and the Canadian public to the need in North Korea has been overwhelming," CFB executive director Jim Cornelius said.
North Korea has been hit hard by several years of crop failures which left its people on the brink of starvation.
"Many new donors from Toronto to Vancouver stepped forward with donations in support of our current shipment," he said.
The Olympic Mentor left Vancouver May 29 and should take 18 to 20 days to reach Nampo, the CFB said.
The CFB is an ecumenical aid agency consisting of 13 Christian churches.
